description: Read the newest comments on one Instagram, Threads, Facebook Page, YouTube, TikTok, Bluesky or Mastodon account's own recent posts, straight from the network (nothing is stored). Each says whether it already has an answer here or a reply from the account on the network. For comment triage use comments_to_answer, which reads every account at once; answer with comment_answers_draft, and when the same question keeps coming, suggest an auto-reply (reply_rule_create). Never like, follow or comment on other accounts.

account_id.description: Only this account's comments (a UUID): from accounts_list

days.description: Posts from the last N days (1 to 7)

unanswered.description: Only comments with no answer here and no reply from the account

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: comments_recent
title: Recent comments
